agent.result_text: The fix works. The change is minimal: in the `keep_attrs=True` lambda, instead of unconditionally accessing `attrs[1]`, it checks `len(attrs) > 1` first. When `x` is a scalar (no attrs to contribute), the attrs list is shorter, so we fall back to empty `{}`. When `x` is an xarray object, behavior is unchanged — attrs from `x` are preserved.
